card.name: Words just before a noun like distress or ulcer
card.fires_on: Fires on a modifier or linking word that comes right before a noun it will modify, such as 'respiratory' before 'distress' or 'gastric' before 'ulcer'. Also on 'may' or a comma that precedes a new clause or list.

modes.label: Body-system adjective
modes.description: An adjective such as respiratory or gastric sits just before a condition noun in a list of signs or events.
modes.example: Clinical signs included swelling of the face, mouth, and throat,<< respiratory>> distress, urticaria, rash,

modes.label: Name or title word
modes.description: The first or middle word of a capitalized name or title, such as Lady or Land, before the rest of the name.
modes.example: Sir Politic,<< Lady>> Politic and Peregrine-play almost

modes.label: Verb or comma before a clause
modes.description: A modal verb or comma that leads into a definition or list of examples.
modes.example: School districts<< may>> be defined as a unique set of census

card.writes: The promoted tokens are all 'str' pieces, so it pushes toward text that begins with 'str' in code-like settings.
card.plain: It marks a spot where a describing word is waiting for the noun it modifies, as in 'respiratory' before 'distress'.
